interface.objects: Atomic types, unit, binary product; old and new atomic representation families.
interface.transport_maps: Arbitrary deterministic Lean functions on atomic values, not arbitrary probabilistic kernels; need not be bijective for forward naturality.
interface.law_scope: Arbitrary PMF, including correlated product input. Tensor here evaluates deterministic components on the same sampled input, not independent sampling.
interface.copyability_theorem_scope: Discrete PMFs on arbitrary Type; no Fintype assumption. Kernel version uses standard classical choice to select a deterministic function.
interface.mac_view: After a single completed MAC run, copy full retained record; duplicate/discard inside one component; tensor with identity; swap. An explicit cell reduces the result to two equal records.
interface.discard_scope: Projection of output values in normalized terminating PMF semantics. Does not erase live cache, earlier context, execution cost or possible nontermination.
interface.full_game_recovery: The MAC view keeps complete records. An arbitrary circuit may discard every record, in which case transport only preserves the corresponding marginal, not recoverability of the full game.

runtime_checks.meaning: Execute the same structural circuit on a Boolean atomic family and the copy/discard circuit on a natural-number family. No runtime simulation of the MAC law is claimed.

exact_probability_checks.meaning: Semantic difference of copying and independent rerunning, not a proof-size gap or new cryptographic security bound.

literature.title: A synthetic approach to Markov kernels, conditional independence and theorems on sufficient statistics
literature.read_scope: Definition 2.1 and surrounding discussion including Example 2.5 opening/footnote 10; section 10 opening, Definition 10.1, Remarks 10.2 and Examples 10.3-10.5 with textual explanation. Not a full-paper reading or artifact reproduction.
literature.comparison: Copy preservation characterizes deterministic morphisms in the cited framework; do not claim this criterion as a new mathematical principle.

literature.read_scope: Abstract and introduction including 1.1-1.5; Theorem 4.1 statement and portions of proof including piece definitions/Lemma 4.6 and 4.4-4.6; section 5 definitions, statements and textual proofs; section 6 definitions, normal-form argument, Lemmas 6.4-6.5, Theorem 6.6 statement/textual proof and Corollary 6.7. Embedded diagram images were not inspected; section 4.2 and the full construction/proofs were not fully read; no artifact rebuild.
literature.comparison: Existing construction already includes copying, discard and monoidal composition, with decomposition and normalization results. Current local transport and nine sound equations neither supersede that theory nor prove a coherent finite presentation.

novelty: Unconfirmed. Structural transport and copyability constraints follow established mathematical principles; current contribution is verified connection to the existing MAC representation edit.
